name: The Cloud Baker's Workshop
description: A whimsical kitchen floating in the clouds where a friendly cloud-baker kneads dough made of cotton candy and bakes cookies that taste like sunshine.
prompt: A charming cloud-shaped kitchen suspended in a pastel sky, complete with candy cane railings and frosting-covered walls. A jolly cloud-baker with flour-dusted cheeks kneads dough made of pink cotton candy while baking cookies that glow with golden sunshine hues. Marshmallow clouds puff around wooden mixing bowls filled with rainbow sprinkles. Soft morning light bathes everything in warm peach tones. Storybook illustration style, cozy fantasy, soft focus.
caption: Fresh from the oven - cookies baked with sunshine and sprinkled with stardust! ☁️🍪
